source: Two practical Spanish instructions during ordinary work; saved together
lessonTheme: Revisa versus revise; publica este diseño
summary: Used valid formal revise during an informal tú recall prompt. Tutor supplied revisa for tú and explained the register difference. Then independently used publica este diseno, por favor; command and masculine este were correct, and diseño spelling was supplied.

observations.outcome: Revise is a valid usted command, but the prompt requested tú. Tutor explained revise / revisa and supplied ñ in diseño. Este and the intended noun were correct; no corrected revisa retry observed.

Correct bare affirmative tú command publica, masculine este and por favor without a fresh publica model. Reused the Spanish noun with n instead of ñ; tutor supplied diseño. No mastery or keyboard limitation inferred.

nextSteps: Recall Revisa este diseño using tú after a gap.
Keep successful publica este ... in use; review ñ spelling separately from command grammar.
assessmentNote: A valid formal command is a register mismatch for an explicit tú prompt, not a generally ungrammatical form. Written spelling and verb recall are assessed separately.
